description: A wire basket sits on the left side of the table, and a small metal tray full of colorful plastic utensils is in front of it. The left hand reaches in and lifts the metal tray out of the basket, then both hands bring it toward the center; the right hand grips the utensils and pulls them out in a bundle, dropping them onto the tabletop, and both hands spread and straighten the loose forks, spoons, and knives into a neat row.
